rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Nyi Blorong, the serpent-bodied Javanese spirit of wealth pacts.
ANATOMY: One beautiful mature woman's head and torso from waist up, exactly two human arms and hands; from waist down ONE immense scaly snake body with ONE tail and NO human legs. Fully opaque green kebaya embroidered with gold, covering chest, shoulders and waist. Heavy overlapping natural golden scales on the serpent coils, no horns, wings or crown invented. [nyi-blorong-c01, nyi-blorong-c05, nyi-blorong-c17]
MOMENT: Rise from a heavy serpent coil toward the viewer, one hand pressing downward as she offers a newly shed gold scale with the other. Her huge snake coils spill across the rocky foreground; her commanding direct stare and towering body are the undeniable subject.
POWER: Pieces of gold are shed from her body's scales and fall physically onto the rock below; not glowing coins or levitating money. The lower body is her documented giant snake form, no extra magic. [nyi-blorong-c05, nyi-blorong-c08, nyi-blorong-c18]
SCALE & CAMERA / LIGHT & WEATHER: Very low angle, coil in foreground and green-clad torso looming above. One shaft of full moon light, hard gold glints on scales and dark green cloth; warm walnut cave shadows and ordinary sea spray.
SURFACE: tactile worn natural surfaces, dense shadows and sharp highlights; painterly material detail, never plastic.
SETTING: A cave among the great rocks of the southern shore, dark ocean surf visible at one edge, recalling the shore of rocks and caves in the tale. [nyi-blorong-c03, nyi-blorong-c12]
MOOD: imposing, dangerous or awe-inspiring; startling anatomy and forceful action, never ordinary, cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, signature, symbol, logo, border, frame or watermark, including corners; no extra heads, eyes or limbs; no film, game, anime or comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Green-kebaya Nyi Blorong rises on snake coils and sheds gold scales.
